mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the capillary sprout to another vessel was most worthwhile: the flowing blood made the new branch’s purpose clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the supporting fibres and then fitting them felt a little repetitive, though the picture explained why both steps mattered.

surprise.text: I was surprised that closing the skin surface still left the deeper tissue needing support and a blood supply.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless. I followed the picture’s pairing of wound messengers and the capillary without understanding exactly how the messengers make a vessel grow.

continue.text: I would probably continue: seeing separate repairs come together was satisfying, and I’d be curious to see another body process explained this way.
